author: Aerosmith
body:
Hello there. I'm proud to announce a new map for Nebula (DTM). This map includes many ways to get from one side to the other, and lots of strategically placed diamonds, chests, and tunnels. Please give me feedback in the comments!

This map was created by mzg33 and I, assisted by SawViper.

Photos: http://imgur.com/a/OGyP9
YML: http://pastebin.com/6rirvamP
Map Download (1.7.10): http://www.mediafire.com/download/5bdgdjed27bged3/Trinity+1.0.zip

Once again, if you have any feedback please express your opinions below!

replies.author: StewieFG
replies.body:
Found a little error on the YML

The last coordinate is the yawl, and it's always 0. And the 3 before that, is the pitch. The possible pitches are 0, 90, -90 and 180. Example is: -1.5,4,6.5,90,0. This is just an example for a yml spawn place. Please fix all your spawns. As for the map, looks great, maybe just more area for PvP and rushing? :)
